title: HubSpot Cuts 660 Jobs In AI Restructuring
content:
HubSpot Cuts 660 Jobs In AI Restructuring 18
			
		 	
				HubSpot is cutting about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 660 employees, as it restructures into what CEO Yamini Rangan described as a "flatter organization" with fewer management layers. Rangan said the layoffs were "not driven by AI-related efficiencies," though AI remains central to HubSpot's strategy as the company adjusts its organization around AI-driven customer outcomes. Fast Company reports:  The layoffs come as investors have spent months questioning whether AI will reduce the need for businesses to pay for software like HubSpot's, a fear dubbed the "SaaSpocalypse." HubSpot's platform helps companies manage their customers, sales, and marketing. The company was removed from the FTSE All-World Index (USD) last month after a decline in its stock price, a report from Simply Wall St noted. The stock is down more than 43% this year as of this writing.
Yamini Rangan, CEO of HubSpot, explicitly told employees in a memo that the layoffs were "not driven by AI-related efficiencies." Rather, the aim was to focus on "aligning our organization with our strategy and how we need to operate going forward," Rangan wrote.  She added that the goal is to "build a flatter organization with fewer layers" by cutting back on management.
Still, artificial intelligence has been central to the company's concerns. In August, Rangan blamed AI for why the company "got off to a slow start" in April as HubSpot was trying to adjust its product and pricing. "We're in the middle of a real transition to AI, and we are making deliberate choices to lead in it," she said on an earnings call.
The restructuring is estimated to cost between $65 and $75 million, mostly in severance packages. The company said that laid-off employees will receive 20 weeks of base pay, one week per year of service (capped at 30 weeks), five months of COBRA and Modern Health healthcare benefits, and they will be allowed to keep their laptops.

report.summary: HubSpot裁员660人重组为扁平组织，加速AI转型
report.background: HubSpot 是知名的 CRM 与营销自动化 SaaS 厂商。2026 年其股价年内累计下跌超 43%，并在上月被移出 FTSE All-World 指数。投资者普遍担忧 AI 会让企业不再需要为这类软件付费，这种恐慌被称为「SaaSpocalypse」（SaaS 末日论）。今年 8 月，CEO Yamini Rangan 曾把公司 4 月增长疲软归咎于 AI 转型期的产品与定价调整。此次裁员 7%，目标是把组织改造成层级更少的「扁平结构」，并围绕 AI 驱动的客户成果重构产品与运营。
key_points: 裁员约 660 人、占员工总数 7%，遣散成本 6500 万至 7500 万美元，补偿含 20 周底薪、每工龄一周（上限 30 周）及 5 个月医保。
CEO 明确否认裁员由「AI 提效」直接造成，称真正目的是砍掉管理层级、把组织结构对齐公司战略。
股价年内跌超 43% 并被移出 FTSE All-World 指数，投资者担心 AI 让企业不再需要付费 SaaS，业内称之为「SaaSpocalypse」。
AI 仍是公司战略核心：CEO 曾把 4 月增长乏力归因于 AI 转型中的产品与定价调整，称要有意识地押注 AI 领先。
这是又一家 SaaS 公司「一边裁员、一边转型 AI」的样本，折射出业绩压力与叙事重构的双重挤压。
report.impact: 对 AI 行业而言，这是 SaaS 商业模式遭 AI 原生替代压力、估值逻辑被重估的又一信号；对开发者来说，传统 CRM/营销自动化岗位收缩，技能需求转向 AI 工程、数据管道与 Agent 集成；对普通用户，短期可能感受到服务与支持响应变慢，但长期产品或更深地内嵌 AI 助手，定价与打包方式也可能随之改变。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注 HubSpot 自家的 Breeze AI 代理套件，以及 Salesforce Agentforce 等竞品；开源侧可看 Twenty、EspoCRM 这类 CRM 项目，配合 LangChain、CrewAI 等 Agent 编排框架，理解「AI 原生 CRM」对传统 SaaS 的替代路径。
